name: What defines a luxury property in the Miami and Fort Lauderdale markets?

mainEntity.name: What defines a luxury property in the Miami and Fort Lauderdale markets?

acceptedAnswer.text: In South Florida's competitive real estate market, luxury properties are typically defined by unique architectural design, premium finishes, expansive waterfront or high-demand urban views, and exclusive amenities. These may include private yacht docks, bespoke smart home systems, or prime locations in areas like Fisher Island, Bal Harbour, or Las Olas. The value often goes beyond size, focusing on rarity, craftsmanship, and lifestyle offerings tailored to discerning buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury properties in South Florida are defined by unique design, premium finishes, exclusive amenities, and prime locations in areas like Fisher Island or Bal Harbour.
